subject: ACK: Post-exam CTA copy (spec 20260224-0035)
body:
Implemented per spec. Commit: f06290a.

- Practice <80%: primary='Run It Back', secondary='See the Board'
- Practice 80-91%: primary='One More Run', secondary='See the Board'
- Practice 92%+: primary='Defend Your Score', secondary='See the Board'
- Real exam: single CTA='See the Board' (no reload CTA; score is locked)
- Bracket uses pct directly (not grade) for clean 80/92 cutoffs
- Note: prior 'Back to Dashboard' string removed from scorecard; nav bar link at line 181 left unchanged (GD spec said scorecard section only)

Ready for GD QA.
